title: Repo Boundary Manifest
description: Schema for repo.manifest.json — the single source of truth for workspace boundaries.

id.description: Stable id used in prompts and .agent scope. e.g. app:web, pkg:ui, root.

owns.description: Glob(s) of files this workspace owns. Used by the scope-guard and CODEOWNERS.

mayImport.description: Workspaces/packages this one is allowed to import.

standalone.description: Whether this app can run on its own with no peer services.

affectsAllApps.description: True for shared packages/root: an edit here has cross-app blast radius.

publicEntry.description: The only legal import paths (must match package.json exports).

protectedPaths.description: Globally-impactful files (tokens, fixtures) that require extra care.

generatedPaths.description: Files produced by a generator; hand-editing is discouraged — regenerate instead.
